# Prospective engineering-conformance requirements

Revision r0.4, 2026-09-09. This is the derived prospective conformance view of
the accepted scientific definition, not additional scientific authority.
No implementation or test below has been run.
They supplement the frozen core; numerical scientific tolerances, inputs and
test populations require the bindings in Q01–Q06 before execution.

Fixed D_a/contributors/support and binary admission × reconstructed flux are
controlled-reference obligations. They are not universal FRUIT restrictions.
For another explicitly declared support-changing method, conformance must
check attributable support transitions and comparison accounting, so loss
cannot masquerade as rejection or convergence. Another approved flux estimator
is checked against its own explicit construction, not forced into a binary
mask. B01–B12-related checks remain conditional on separate Q02 adoption.

FRUIT Learn, Consider and Apply shall be visible runtime responsibilities with
explicit evidence, resolved decisions and applied operands. PTC retains its
own learning/resolution/application boundary. Reuse existing method, product,
state and lineage structures; this paper specifies neither new classes nor
redundant registries. VAL participates at the declared learning and decision
boundaries, while MAP and NOI retain their scientific authority.

Conformance is evidence about declared behavior, not a source-recovery result.
Executed evidence must identify exact method, upstream contracts, inputs,
realized states, tolerances, outputs and failures. Scientific comparisons and
independent replication are separate requirements in the experiment proposal.

After an experiment is authorized, routine implementation defects within its
fixed method and scope may be repaired without asking again. A change to the
scientific method, gate, population, input or scope stops the affected work for
owner disposition; it is not a routine bug fix. All existing products survive.
